svg.title: static_ref decode: the one full-chunk write
svg.text: decode: pop the header, then write every value of the chunk once, into the out array of the next envelope
15 REPEAT: the array of slot arg (no lookup)
0 INLINE: statics.lookup(sha, the frame in the header)
statics/ in a sidecar on the search path (inline: true: none, the frames are in the header)
out has the stage's input shape (2, 17, 2, ·), so the adapter (zarr3.FieldStageBytesCodec) passes the array inside the
envelope it allocates for the stages before (here field_terms, which then works on it in place); when static_ref is the first
stage, out is a new array that zarr gets as the bare chunk. Every value is written once: 2 block copies of the kept fields and 20 slot writes.
